data.narrative:
Bellatrix Aerospace is a pre-Series B stage company in Space & Aerospace that has raised $31M to date. The comparable universe consists of 5 public peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Sierra Space, Planet Labs, Impulse Space, and Apex Space.

Two standard valuation methods proved inapplicable to this analysis. Peer-median triangulation failed due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the Space & Aerospace sector—while 11 same-sector peers exist, none of the narrow filters (stage-matched, adjacent-stage, or valuation-tier-matched) yielded the minimum 3 datapoints required for a robust median. Public-comp anchoring could not be applied because Bellatrix's revenue is not on file; the median P/S for the 6-ticker Space & Aerospace public set is 23.9x, but this multiple cannot be deployed without the target's revenue figure.

This analysis reaches an impasse: neither standard triangulation method is supportable with available data. A valuation range cannot be responsibly derived without either (1) revenue disclosure from the target, enabling public-comp anchoring, or (2) access to valuation metrics from 3+ private peers at the same stage and capital raise tier. The $31M raised provides a floor reference, but requires additional financial or transaction data to establish a defensible post-money valuation.
